title: NFTStakerDepletion._syncBudget no-hook-branch NatSpec claims 'pure recompute'; post-story-020 it settles accrual only (doc drift)
description: Post-story-020 the no-hook branch of _syncBudget settles accrual only (pure _updatePool, no _recomputeSchedule), but the NatSpec still claims it 'behaves like a pure recompute'. The docstring was made stale BY the story-020 fix. No functional impact: every config setter recomputes directly, so no code path relies on the stale claim.
impact: None (documentation-only). Risk is future-maintenance confusion only; runtime behaviour is correct and unchanged.
attackPath: No exploit. A reader/maintainer trusts the stale NatSpec and assumes the no-hook branch recomputes the schedule.
Runtime behaviour is correct; risk is maintenance confusion only.
recommendation: Update the _syncBudget no-hook-branch NatSpec to 'settles accrual only; no recompute'.
category: QA doc-drift introduced by the story-020 fix (Law-2 faithfulness cross-ref)
